`MortSubtableConverter` confines decoding to the subtable’s declared bytes. For contextual substitutions, `_readClassicSubstitutions` limits glyph indices so each replacement word ends no later than `size`, and `_readClassicArray` additionally rejects reads past the bounded reader’s data. Thus even an odd-length subtable cannot supply a replacement from a partial or out-of-bounds word.
YES
